usage: deskops retire [-h] [--root ROOT] --reason REASON --ref REF [--force]
                      path

positional arguments:
  path             Path of the file under desk/ to retire (pills, inbox notes, steps, roles, runtimes, faq, logbook, materializations, leftovers).

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT      Target repository root
  --reason REASON  Why the document is obsolete.
  --ref REF        Commit (HEAD or an ancestor) or existing path that replaces or resolves it. Repeatable.
  --force          Retire even when other desk or docs files still reference it.

Example:
  deskops retire desk/contexts/pill-old.md --root . \
    --reason "Describes the retired routine primitives" --ref a0e00e3

Tasks, drawer entries, atoms and registry entries keep their own verbs:
closeout, drawer remove, atoms delete, repo remove.
